text:
liam: FYI seeing gRPC streams to our model-serving pods stall intermittently on east-west paths, GPUs stay busy but clients hang on "waiting for next chunk"
olga: Which cluster/region?
liam: prod-gpu-us-east1, nodepool p3-sriov — started after last night's node rollout
maya: Could be MTU mismatch between host and SR-IOV VFs, that's a classic for fragmented gRPC chunks
sam: Ran quick check on one affected node:
```
# ip link show eno1
3: eno1: mtu 9000 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
# ip link show eth0
4: eth0: mtu 1500 qdisc noop state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
```
sam: host NIC = 9000, VF/VF-backed pod iface = 1500
liam: that explains the streaming stalls — large responses get fragmented/blackholed, gRPC windowing chokes
olga: How did VFs end up at 1500? We didn't change CNI mtus in the rollout AFAIK
maya: Kernel bump + SR-IOV driver version changed ordering of vf config in our image; CNI hook that set MTU didn't run for VFs on boot
jun: infra-bot logged the nodepool rolling update at 1754980000, maybe correlation
sam: Quick mitigation: sync VF MTU to host and bounce the RDMA/DPDK stack — immediate recovery on canary
```
# sudo ip link set eth0 mtu 9000
# sudo systemctl restart rdma.transport.service || true
# kubectl rollout restart daemonset/model-sidecar -n ml-serving
```
liam: confirmed — after mtu set to 9000 streams resumed and GPU jobs finished normally
maya: Need a durable fix: 1) ensure CNI sets VF MTU during pod setup, 2) add node-init daemonset that reconciles host<->vf mtus on boot, 3) add monitoring alert when host_mtu != pod_iface_mtu for SR-IOV pools
olga: Also add preflight check in node image QA so future rollouts don't regress this again
sam: I'll push a short-lived daemonset that runs on all p3-sriov nodes to reconcile MTU and report diffs; rolling to canary now
infra-bot: deploy-bot: patch/mtu-reconciler daemonset started - canary on 2 nodes
liam: FYI this caused ~4 model-serving retries and a couple of 8hr GPU jobs to restart — rough cost hit, estimate ~$1.3k wasted GPU hours, flagging to finance and SRE cost-sig
maya: Filed runbook + ticket: INFRA-4123, assigned to eng-infra and eng-runtime. Includes remediation steps and testcases (unit + e2e).
jun: I'll add alert to pager duty if >2 nodes report mtus out of sync in a 1h window
liam: thanks all :thumbsup:
